title: Visayas braces for rain as Cebu heat index stays at ‘extreme caution’ level

blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines — Several parts of the Visayas are expected to experience cloudy skies and rain on Saturday, November 7, while Cebu’s heat index is forecast to reach 38 degrees Celsius, falling under the “extreme caution” category. The easterlies, or winds coming from the Pacific Ocean, are affecting the Visayas and other parts of the country outside Luzon, where the northeast monsoon, or Amihan, continues to prevail.
